note: Shot-first short prompts (2026-09-20). The long shared bible in 02-prompts.md drowned the THIS SHOT sentence on FLUX.2 [klein]; these put the shot first, then a one-line home palette, then a one-line photo style. Final prompt = shot + ' ' + homes[projectId] + ' ' + style.
style: Photorealistic interior photograph for a Korean apartment renovation portfolio, 24mm lens, level camera at chest height, straight vertical lines, soft natural daylight, clean move-in-ready empty surfaces, realistic 2.4 m ceiling, unbranded appliances, nobody in the room.
